baseline_source: workspace cache copied from the public Infinite-Mobility release

adapter.multi_mesh_urdf_policy: concatenate meshes belonging to one URDF visual before urdfpy serialization
adapter.package_path_policy: generate in baseline-relative staging, then normalize URDF mesh references to package-relative paths

notes: This freezes the 20 factory names published in the baseline README.
The cohort is a public-factory supplementary baseline, not a common-category matched result.
No rendering or GPU is used. Each factory-seed case runs in a fresh Blender process.
Texture baking is retained at 64 px only to exercise package export; these packages are not used for appearance or production-readiness ranking.
